wrap: [VERB 动词] (用纸、布等)包，裹； wrap wrap up 同 wrap When you wrap something, you fold paper or cloth tightly round it to cover it completely, for example in order to protect it or so that you can give it to someone as a present.  /  [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 包装材料;包裹物； wrap Wrap is the material that something is wrapped in.  /  [VERB 动词] 用…包;用…裹； wrap When you wrap something such as a piece of paper or cloth round another thing, you put it around it.  /  [VERB 动词] 用(手臂、指头或腿)围紧;用…绕住； wrap If someone wraps their arms, fingers, or legs around something, they put them firmly around it.
wrapped up: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 专心致志的；全神贯注的；完全沉浸的； wrapped up If someone is wrapped up in a particular person or thing, they spend nearly all their time thinking about them, so that they forget about other things which may be important.
wrapper: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (尤指用于食品的)包装纸,包装塑料,包装用金属薄纸； wrapper A wrapper is a piece of paper, plastic, or thin metal which covers and protects something that you buy, especially food.
wrapping: [N-VAR 可变名词] 包装纸;包装塑料；包装材料； wrapping Wrapping is something such as paper or plastic which is used to cover and protect something.
wrapping paper: [N-MASS 物质名词] (礼品)包装纸； Wrapping paper is special paper which is used for wrapping presents.
wrap up: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 穿得暖和； wrap up If you wrap up , you put warm clothes on.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 圆满完成，圆满结束(工作、协议等)； wrap up If you wrap up something such as a job or an agreement, you complete it in a satisfactory way.  /  See also: wrap 1 ; wrapped up ; �
wrath: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 同 anger； wrath Wrath means the same as anger .
wreak: [VERB 动词] 造成(混乱或破坏)； wreak Something or someone that wreaks havoc or destruction causes a great amount of disorder or damage.  /  [VERB 动词] 实施(报复)； wreak If you wreak revenge or vengeance on someone, you do something that will harm them very much to punish them for the harm they have done to you.  /  See also: wrought ; �
wreath: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 用于祭奠的花圈； wreath A wreath is an arrangement of flowers and leaves, usually in the shape of a circle, which you put on a grave or by a statue to show that you remember a person who has died or people who have died.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 头上戴的花环，花冠； A wreath is a circle of leaves or flowers which someone wears around their head.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 某些人圣诞节时挂在家门上的花环； A wreath is a circle of leaves which some people hang on the front door of their house at Christmas.
wreathe: [VERB 动词] (烟、雾等)笼罩，缭绕； wreathe If something is wreathed in smoke or mist, it is surrounded by it.  /  [VERB 动词] 花草环绕;用花环等装饰； wreathe If something is wreathed with flowers or leaves, it has a circle or chain of flowers or leaves put round it.
wreck: [VERB 动词] 毁掉;毁坏;损坏； wreck wrecker To wreck something means to completely destroy or ruin it.  /  [VERB 动词] 使(船舶)失事；使遇难； wreck If a ship is wrecked , it is damaged so much that it sinks or can no longer sail.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 失事的船只(或汽车、飞机);损毁的建筑； wreck A wreck is something such as a ship, car, plane, or building which has been destroyed, usually in an accident.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 车祸；交通事故； wreck A wreck is an accident in which a moving vehicle hits something and is damaged or destroyed.
wreckage: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] (飞机、汽车等的)残骸；建筑物等的废墟； wreckage When something such as a plane, car, or building has been destroyed, you can refer to what remains as wreckage or the wreckage .  /  [N-SING 单数名词] (计划等失败或遭到破坏后的)残余； wreckage If something such as a plan has failed or been spoilt completely, you can refer to what remains as the wreckage of it.
wrecker: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 事故发生后拖走坏损车辆的救援车，救险车，清障车； A wrecker is a motor vehicle which is used to pull broken or damaged vehicles to a place where they can be repaired or broken up, for example after an accident.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 拆除废旧建筑者； Wreckers are people whose job involves destroying old, unwanted, or damaged buildings.  /  See also: wreck ; �
wren: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 鹪鹩； A wren is a very small brown bird.
wrench: [VERB 动词] 猛拉;猛拧;猛拽； wrench If you wrench something that is fixed in a particular position, you pull or twist it violently, in order to move or remove it.  /  [VERB 动词] 挣脱;挣开； wrench If you wrench yourself free from someone who is holding you, you get away from them by suddenly twisting the part of your body that is being held.  /  [VERB 动词] 扭伤(关节)； wrench If you wrench one of your joints, you twist it and injure it.  /  [N-SING 单数名词] (离别时的)痛苦，愁楚； wrench If you say that leaving someone or something is a wrench , you feel very sad about it.
wrest: [VERB 动词] (尤指艰难或非法地)攫取，抢夺； wrest If you wrest something from someone else, you take it from them, especially when this is difficult or illegal.  /  [VERB 动词] 抢，夺(物品)； wrest If you wrest something from someone who is holding it, you take it from them by pulling or twisting it violently.
wrestle: [VERB 动词] 试图解决;绞尽脑汁处理； wrestle When you wrestle with a difficult problem, you try to deal with it.  /  [VERB 动词] 摔跤;扭斗； wrestle If you wrestle with someone, you fight them by forcing them into painful positions or throwing them to the ground, rather than by hitting them.  /  [VERB 动词] 使劲搬动;用力移动； wrestle If you wrestle a person or thing somewhere, you move them there using a lot of force, for example by twisting a part of someone's body into a painful position.  /  See also: wrestling ; �
wrestler: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 摔跤运动员； A wrestler is someone who wrestles as a sport, usually for money.
wrestling: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 摔跤(运动)； wrestling Wrestling is a sport in which two people wrestle and try to throw each other to the ground.
wretch: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 不幸的人;可怜的人； wretch You can refer to someone as a wretch when you feel sorry for them because they are unhappy or unfortunate.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 坏蛋;恶棍;卑鄙小人； wretch You can refer to someone as a wretch when you think that they are wicked or if they have done something you are angry about.
wretched: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 不幸的;可怜的;苦难的； wretched wretchedly wretchedness You describe someone as wretched when you feel sorry for them because they are in an unpleasant situation or have suffered unpleasant experiences.  /  [ADJ 形容词] 讨厌的;混账的;该死的； wretched You use wretched to describe someone or something that you dislike or feel angry with.  /  [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 苦恼的;难过的;哀伤的； wretched wretchedly wretchedness Someone who feels wretched feels very unhappy.  /  [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 恶劣的;低劣的； wretched If you describe something as wretched , you are emphasizing that it is very bad or of very poor quality.
wriggle: [VERB 动词] 蠕动，扭动(身体的一部分)； wriggle If you wriggle or wriggle part of your body, you twist and turn with quick movements, for example because you are uncomfortable.  /  [VERB 动词] 扭动着行进;蠕动着行进； wriggle If you wriggle somewhere, for example through a small gap, you move there by twisting and turning your body.  /  相关词组： wriggle out of �
wriggle out of: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 设法摆脱，逃避(应做的事情)； wriggle out of If you say that someone has wriggled out of doing something, you disapprove of the fact that they have managed to avoid doing it, although they should have done it.
wring: [VERB 动词] 强行取得;逼取； wring If you wring something out of someone, you manage to make them give it to you even though they do not want to.  /  [PHRASE 短语] (通常因忧愁、焦虑而)绞扭双手[干叹息)； If someone wrings their hands , they hold them together and twist and turn them, usually because they are very worried or upset about something.  /  [PHRASE 短语] 扭断…的脖子(表示非常生某人的气)； wring If you say that you will wring someone's neck or that you would like to wring their neck , you mean that you are very angry or irritated with them.  /  相关词组： wring out �
wringer: [PHRASE 短语] 受尽折磨;历尽艰辛； If you say that someone has been put through the wringer or has gone through the wringer , you mean that they have suffered a very difficult or unpleasant experience.
wring out: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 把…拧干； wring out When you wring out a wet cloth or a wet piece of clothing, you squeeze the water out of it by twisting it strongly.
wrinkle: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (脸上的)皱纹； wrinkle Wrinkles are lines which form on someone's face as they grow old.  /  [V-ERG 及物/不及物动词] 使皮肤起皱纹； wrinkle wrinkled When someone's skin wrinkles or when something wrinkles it, lines start to form in it because the skin is getting old or damaged.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 布或纸的褶皱，皱痕，褶子； wrinkle A wrinkle is a raised fold in a piece of cloth or paper that spoils its appearance.  /  [V-ERG 及物/不及物动词] 使衣服起皱，起褶； wrinkle wrinkled If cloth wrinkles , or if someone or something wrinkles it, it gets folds or lines in it.
wrinkly: [ADJ 形容词] 起皱的;有皱痕的； wrinkly A wrinkly surface has a lot of wrinkles on it.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] (年轻人对老人的戏称，尤用于拿老人开玩笑或取笑他们的举止时)老皱皮，老东西； Young people sometimes refer to older people as wrinklies , especially when they are teasing them or making fun of the way they behave.
wrist: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 腕;手腕； Your wrist is the part of your body between your hand and your arm which bends when you move your hand.
wristwatch: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 手表；腕表； A wristwatch is a watch with a strap which you wear round your wrist.
writ: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 令状;法院命令;传票； writ A writ is a legal document that orders a person to do a particular thing.  /  [PHRASE 短语] 明显的;显而易见的； writ If you say that something is writ large , you mean that it is very obvious.  /  [PHRASE 短语] 扩大了的;夸大了的； writ If you say that one thing is another thing writ large , you mean that the first thing is a larger or more exaggerated version of the second thing.
write: [VERB 动词] 写;书写;写字； write When you write something on a surface, you use something such as a pen or pencil to produce words, letters, or numbers on the surface.  /  [VERB 动词] 写(书、诗等);创作(歌曲)； write If you write something such as a book, a poem, or a piece of music, you create it and record it on paper or perhaps on a computer.  /  [VERB 动词] 写作，著述通常以出版为目的； write Someone who writes creates books, stories, or articles, usually for publication.  /  [VERB 动词] 写信;给…写信(美国英语亦可用 write someone)； write When you write to someone or write them a letter, you give them information, ask them something, or express your feelings in a letter.
write back: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 写回信； If you write back to someone who has sent you a letter, you write them a letter in reply.
write down: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 写下;记下； write down When you write something down , you record it on a piece of paper using a pen or pencil.
write-in: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (美国选举中)投给非推荐候选人的票； write-in In the US, a write-in is a vote that you make by writing the candidate's name on the ballot paper.
write in: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] (向某一机构)写信，发信； write in If you write in to an organization, you send them a letter.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] (美国选举中)在选票上加写(非候选人的姓名)； write in In the United States, if someone who is voting in an election writes in a person whose name is not on the list of candidates, they write that person's name on the voting paper and vote for him or her.  /  See also: write-in ; �
write into: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 将(某一条款或细节)写入(合同、法律或协议)； If a rule or detail is written into a contract, law, or agreement, it is included in it when the contract, law, or agreement is made.
write-off: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (发生事故后)报废的车辆； write-off Something such as a vehicle that is a write-off has been so badly damaged in an accident that it is not worth repairing.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] (债务或花费的)注销，勾销； write-off A write-off is the decision by a company or government to accept that they will never recover a debt or an amount of money that has been spent on something.  /  [N-SING 单数名词] 失败的计划;白费的时间； write-off If you describe a plan or period of time as a write-off , you mean that it has been a failure and you have achieved nothing.
write off: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] (向公司或机构)去函，发信； If you write off to a company or organization, you send them a letter, usually asking for something.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 勾销，注销(债务或已花费的款项)； write off If someone writes off a debt or an amount of money that has been spent on a project, they accept that they are never going to get the money back.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 认定…不重要(或无用)；忽视； write off If you write someone or something off , you decide that they are unimportant or useless and that they are not worth further serious attention.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] (发生撞车后)将(车辆)报废； If someone writes off a vehicle, they have a crash in it and it is so badly damaged that it is not worth repairing.
write out: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 写出(篇幅较长的报告或清单)； write out When you write out something fairly long such as a report or a list, you write it on paper.  /  [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 使(系列剧中的人物)不再出场； If a character in a drama series is written out , he or she is taken out of the series.  /  »see: write 6 ; »see: write 5 ; �
writer: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (专业)作家； writer A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 特定文章、报告、信件或故事的作者，撰写者； writer The writer of a particular article, report, letter, or story is the person who wrote it.
write-up: [N-COUNT 可数名词] (报刊上对电影、饭店、新产品等的)评论，评述； write-up A write-up is an article in a newspaper or magazine, in which someone gives their opinion of something such as a film, restaurant, or new product.
write up: [PHRASAL VERB 短语动词] 把…整理成文；详细写出所做的事或所说的话； See also: write-up ; If you write up something that has been done or said, you record it on paper in a neat and complete form, usually using notes that you have made.
writhe: [VERB 动词] (通常指由于剧痛或不适而)扭动，翻滚； writhe If you writhe , your body twists and turns violently backwards and forwards, usually because you are in great pain or discomfort.
writing: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] (写下或印出的)文字； writing Writing is something that has been written or printed.  /  [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] (尤指评论语言风格时的)文字作品，文章； writing You can refer to any piece of written work as writing , especially when you are considering the style of language used in it.  /  [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] (尤指为赚取稿费而进行的)写作； writing Writing is the activity of writing, especially of writing books for money.  /  [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 笔迹;字迹;书写； writing Your writing is the way that you write with a pen or pencil, which can usually be recognized as belonging to you.
writing desk: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 写字台； A writing desk is a piece of furniture with drawers, an area for keeping writing materials, and a surface on which you can rest your paper while writing.
writing paper: [N-MASS 物质名词] 信纸； Writing paper is paper for writing letters on.
written: + + + Written is the past participle of write .  /  [ADJ 形容词] (测验、作业等)书面的，笔头的； written A written test or piece of work is one which involves writing rather than doing something practical or giving spoken answers.  /  [ADJ 形容词] (协议、规定、法律等)成文的，书面的； written A written agreement, rule, or law has been officially written down.  /  to be written all over someone's face » see: face �
written word: [N-SING 单数名词] (尤指与言语或绘画、电影等其他表达形式相对的)书面语； written word You use the written word to refer to language expressed in writing, especially when contrasted with speech or with other forms of expression such as painting or film.
wrong: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 有麻烦的;有问题的； wrong If you say there is something wrong , you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.  /  [ADJ 形容词] (选择)错误的，不适宜的； wrong If you choose the wrong thing, person, or method, you make a mistake and do not choose the one that you really want.  /  [ADJ 形容词] (决定、选择、行动等)错误的，不适当的； wrong If something such as a decision, choice, or action is the wrong one, it is not the best or most suitable one.  /  [ADJ 形容词] 不正确的;与事实不符的； wrong wrongly If something is wrong , it is incorrect and not in accordance with the facts.
wrongdoer: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 作恶者;违法犯罪者； A wrongdoer is a person who does things that are immoral or illegal.
wrongdoing: [N-VAR 可变名词] 违法行为;犯罪行为;不道德行为； wrongdoing Wrongdoing is behaviour that is illegal or immoral.
wrong-foot: [VERB 动词] 使措手不及;使仓皇失措;使方寸大乱； wrong-foot If you wrong-foot someone, you surprise them by putting them into an unexpected or difficult situation.
wrongful: [ADJ 形容词] 违法的;不道德的;不公正的； wrongful wrongfully A wrongful act is one that is illegal, immoral, or unjust.
wrong-headed: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 冥顽不化的;执迷不悟的； If you describe someone as wrong-headed , you mean that although they act in a determined way, their actions and ideas are based on wrong judgments.
wrote: + + + Wrote is the past tense of write .
wrought: [VERB 动词] 引起;造成； wrought If something has wrought a change, it has made it happen.  /  [ADJ 形容词] 以…原料制造的;以…方式制作的； wrought If something is wrought in a particular material or in a particular way, it has been created in that material or way.  /  See also: wreak ; �
wrought iron: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 锻铁;熟铁； Wrought iron is a type of iron that is easily formed into shapes and is used especially for making gates, fences, and furniture.
wrung: + + + Wrung is the past tense of wring .
wry: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] (表情)哭笑不得的； wry wryly If someone has a wry expression, it shows that they find a bad situation or a change in a situation slightly amusing.  /  [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 话语或文章挖苦的，讽刺的，揶揄的； wry wryly A wry remark or piece of writing refers to a bad situation or a change in a situation in an amusing way.
wt: + + + Wt is a written abbreviation for (书面缩略=) weight .
WTO: [N-PROPER 专有名词] WTO WTO is an abbreviation for (缩略=) World Trade Organization .
wuss: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 胆小鬼;懦夫； If you call someone a wuss , you are criticizing them for being afraid.
WWW: (用于网址的开头)万维网； WWW is an abbreviation for (缩略=) 'World Wide Web'.
WYSIWYG: 所见即所得，直接可视数据(指计算机屏幕上显示的和打印出来的材料完全一致)； WYSIWYG WYSIWYG is used to refer to a computer screen display which exactly matches the way that a document will appear when it is printed.
X: [N-VAR 可变名词] 英语字母表的第24个字母； X is the twenty-fourth letter of the English alphabet.  /  用于度量单位间表示“乘以”； When writing down the size of something, you can use x in between the measurements to mean 'by'.  /  [N-PROPER 专有名词] 用于表示不知道或不愿透露的人名某，X； X X can be used to represent the name of a person when you do not know their real name, or when you are trying to keep their real name a secret.  /  用于表示不确定或无需指明的数量； X You can use X or x to refer to a number or amount when you do not know exactly how much it is, or when this information is not important.
X chromosome: [N-COUNT 可数名词] X 染色体； An X chromosome is one of an identical pair of chromosomes found in a woman's cells, or one of a non-identical pair found in a man's cells.
xenophobia: [N-UNCOUNT 不可数名词] 仇外情绪，惧外情绪对外国人的强烈厌恶或惧怕； Xenophobia is strong and unreasonable dislike or fear of people from other countries.
xenophobic: [ADJ-GRADED 能被表示程度的副词或介词词组修饰的形容词] 仇外的;惧外的； xenophobic If you describe someone as xenophobic , you disapprove of them because they show strong dislike or fear of people from other countries.
Xerox: [N-COUNT 可数名词] 施乐复印机； Xerox A Xerox is a machine that can make copies of pieces of paper which have writing or other marks on them.  /  [N-COUNT 可数名词] 施乐复印件； A Xerox is a copy of something written or printed on a piece of paper, which has been made using a Xerox machine.  /  [VERB 动词] 用施乐复印机复印； Xerox If you Xerox a document, you make a copy of it using a Xerox machine.
Xmas: 用于非正式笔语中圣诞节； Xmas Xmas is used in informal written English to represent the word Christmas.
